title: The two relic dies recovered for Pennywell's coin-rite (Sarel's reverse die, Slade's obverse die) stay in the carried-items list unchanged - 'wants the obverse to be struck true', 'silver-black with age' - even after the town's press is reported striking 'an old king's face now.' It's never said whether the actual relics were used or the new press just adopted the old style; the items are never consumed or referenced again once the bargain resolves, so a player is left guessing what physically happened to them.
where: The Vault-Door, Pennywell / after 'tell her the vault stays sealed'
